atoms.text: This level includes mentions of uncomfortable situations both at school and at home. If this level upsets you, you should speak with a trusted adult about it.

instruction.text: Decide whether Rebecca responded well to the situation.

atoms.a: Someone online sent Rebecca nasty messages that made her feel uncomfortable. She responded by talking to her dog about it.

feedback.end: This wasn’t the smartest response because her dog isn’t able to talk back or help her fix the situation.

instruction.text: Decide which response would’ve been better.

feedback.end: By telling a trusted adult like her mum, they will be able to talk through what happened and block or report the account of the person who sent the nasty messages.

b.sound: not telling anyone about what happened
telling her mum about what happened

instruction.text: Decide whether Janelle responded well to the situation.

atoms.a: Janelle was at basketball training with her friends when a stranger approached her and told her he was a friend of her dad’s. Janelle trusted the man and left with him.

feedback.end: This was a very dangerous response. Since Janelle didn’t know the man, she had no idea where he would take her or if he could be trusted.

instruction.text: Decide which response would’ve been better.

feedback.end: By not trusting the man and asking her basketball coach for help, they can call Janelle’s dad to check if he has sent someone to pick her up from training.

b.sound: punching the man until he leaves
telling her coach what has happened and asking for help

instruction.text: Decide whether Pradeep responded well to the situation.

atoms.a: Pradeep was at the park with his brother. A stranger approached them and asked them what school they go to. They tried to be kind and told her the name of their school.

feedback.end: This wasn’t a very safe response because they have shared their personal information with a stranger.

instruction.text: Decide which response would’ve been better.

feedback.end: They are protecting their personal information by not answering the question. By telling their parents, they can get advice and make sure they remain safe in the future.

b.sound: screaming in her face and shouting at her
telling her they won’t answer that question and later telling their parents what happened
